indexes.definition: CREATE INDEX idx_dhr_review_pending_workflow ON public.dhr_summary_review USING btree (workflow_instance_id) WHERE ((status)::text = 'PENDING_REVIEW'::text)

CREATE INDEX idx_workflow_task_done_assignee_id ON public.workflow_task USING btree (assignee_id, id DESC) INCLUDE (instance_id, node_id) WHERE ((status)::text = ANY ((ARRAY['COMPLETED'::character varying, 'REJECTED'::character varying])::text[]))
